description: Two destroy invocations, four deletes, one node. The destroy nodes stand for a whole state level rather than a group, so a delete is matched by ENVIRONMENT and never by address — which is also why the stub topology gives destroy.stage no members at all. Nothing carries an identifier: terraform's apply_complete for a delete has no id_key, and the page shows nothing rather than inventing one. Since ADR-0090 the same deletes are read a second way, by ADDRESS, so the estate tiles can go dark one at a time: `deleting` carries the noun, `nodes` still carries the level.
